blocks.zh: 適用範圍、規範性引用文件與術語定義 — ISO 9001+GMP雙軌要求
blocks.en: Scope, Normative References and Terms and Definitions - The ISO 9001 + GMP Dual-Track Requirements

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 15378 的雙軌架構：ISO 9001:2015 要求 + GMP 特定要求疊加
blocks.en: Understand the dual-track architecture of ISO 15378: ISO 9001:2015 requirements with GMP-specific requirements layered on top

blocks.zh: 掌握標準適用範圍：哪些組織必須遵循、哪些不在範圍內
blocks.en: Know the scope of the standard: which organizations must comply and which are out of scope

blocks.zh: 辨識初級包裝材料 (primary packaging material) 的定義與典型範例
blocks.en: Recognize the definition and typical examples of primary packaging material

blocks.zh: 理解 PDCA 循環與風險思維在 GMP 環境中的應用
blocks.en: Understand how the PDCA cycle and risk-based thinking apply in a GMP environment

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Section 3 全部術語定義，特別是 batch、validation、qualification 等核心詞彙
blocks.en: Become familiar with all the Section 3 definitions, especially core terms such as batch, validation and qualification

blocks.zh: 了解如何在供應商稽核中活用 ISO 15378 認證
blocks.en: Learn how to use ISO 15378 certification in supplier audits

blocks.zh: Foreword — 前言
blocks.en: Foreword

blocks.zh: 前言解析
blocks.en: Foreword Analysis

blocks.zh: 第四版的重大意義：2017 版將 GMP 要求完全整合進 ISO 9001:2015 架構，不再是附加文件，而是真正的「雙軌標準」。
blocks.en: Significance of the fourth edition: The 2017 edition fully integrates GMP requirements into the ISO 9001:2015 structure. They are no longer an add-on document but a true "dual-track standard".

blocks.zh: 排版識別規則 — 如何閱讀這份標準
blocks.en: Typographic Convention - How to Read This Standard

blocks.zh: 框框內的文字：直接引自 ISO 9001:2015 的原文，未修改。
blocks.en: Text inside the boxes: quoted directly from ISO 9001:2015, unmodified.

blocks.zh: 框框外的文字：ISO 15378 新增的 GMP 特定要求或建議，這是初級包裝材料廠商需要額外滿足的部分。
blocks.en: Text outside the boxes: GMP-specific requirements or recommendations added by ISO 15378, which primary packaging material manufacturers must meet in addition.

blocks.zh: 讀標準時，先看框框外的文字，因為那才是 ISO 15378「超出 ISO 9001」的部分，也是供應商稽核時要特別檢查的重點。
blocks.en: When reading the standard, look first at the text outside the boxes, because that is the part where ISO 15378 goes "beyond ISO 9001" and is the focus of attention in supplier audits.

blocks.zh: 刪除「品質手冊」要求
blocks.en: Removal of the "Quality Manual" Requirement

blocks.zh: 2015 版以前要求企業要有一份品質手冊 (quality manual)。2017 版配合 ISO 9001:2015，不再強制要求品質手冊的形式，但品質管理系統的文件化要求仍然存在，只是形式更彈性。
blocks.en: Before the 2015 edition, organizations were required to have a quality manual. The 2017 edition, aligned with ISO 9001:2015, no longer mandates a quality manual as such, but the documentation requirements for the quality management system still exist; the form is simply more flexible.

blocks.zh: Introduction 0.1 — General 總則
blocks.en: Introduction 0.1 - General

blocks.zh: "shall" — a requirement (強制要求)
blocks.en: "shall" - a requirement

blocks.zh: "should" — a recommendation (建議)
blocks.en: "should" - a recommendation

blocks.zh: "may" — a permission (許可)
blocks.en: "may" - a permission

blocks.zh: "can" — a possibility or capability (可能性)
blocks.en: "can" - a possibility or capability

blocks.zh: 0.1 解析 — 標準的本質
blocks.en: 0.1 Analysis - The Nature of the Standard

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 = ISO 9001 + GMP 的雙軌架構
blocks.en: ISO 15378 = ISO 9001 + GMP: The Dual-Track Architecture

blocks.zh: 可以把 ISO 15378 想成一棟建築：
blocks.en: Think of ISO 15378 as a building:

blocks.zh: 地基 = ISO 9001:2015（品質管理系統通用框架）
blocks.en: Foundation = ISO 9001:2015 (the generic quality management system framework)

blocks.zh: 上層建築 = GMP 特定要求（為藥品包裝材料量身訂製）
blocks.en: Superstructure = GMP-specific requirements (tailored for pharmaceutical packaging materials)

blocks.zh: 供應商若取得 ISO 15378 認證，代表他們的 QMS 同時滿足兩套要求，達到製藥等級的品質管理水準。
blocks.en: A supplier holding ISO 15378 certification has a QMS that satisfies both sets of requirements, reaching a pharmaceutical-grade level of quality management.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽核實務應用
blocks.en: Practical Application in CDMO Audits

blocks.zh: 當你在做橡膠塞或玻璃瓶供應商的資格審查 (supplier qualification) 時：
blocks.en: When you carry out supplier qualification for a rubber stopper or glass vial supplier:

blocks.zh: 情境 A：供應商持有 ISO 15378 認證 → 可以縮短稽核範圍，重點確認認證有效性和近期監察報告，不必從零審查 QMS 框架。
blocks.en: Scenario A: The supplier holds ISO 15378 certification → the audit scope can be reduced. Focus on confirming the validity of the certificate and recent surveillance reports, without reviewing the QMS framework from scratch.

blocks.zh: 情境 B：供應商只有 ISO 9001 認證 → 需要額外稽核 GMP 相關要求（生產控制、批次紀錄、留樣等），工作量大幅增加。
blocks.en: Scenario B: The supplier holds only ISO 9001 certification → additional audit of GMP-related requirements is needed (production controls, batch records, retention samples, etc.), so the workload increases significantly.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 認證就是供應商的「GMP 資格預審證明」。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 certification serves as the supplier's "GMP pre-qualification evidence".

blocks.zh: "if appropriate" 的法律意涵
blocks.en: The Legal Implication of "if appropriate"

blocks.zh: 這個詞組很重要：ISO 15378 預設所有標有 "if appropriate" 的要求都是適用的，除非企業能提出書面理由說明為何不適用。這意味著「不適用」的舉證責任在企業身上，不能輕易略過。
blocks.en: This phrase is important: ISO 15378 presumes that every requirement marked "if appropriate" applies, unless the organization can give a documented justification for why it does not. This means the burden of proof for "not applicable" rests on the organization, and requirements cannot be skipped lightly.

blocks.zh: Introduction 0.2 — Quality Management Principles 品質管理原則
blocks.en: Introduction 0.2 - Quality Management Principles

blocks.zh: Customer focus — 以顧客為核心
blocks.en: Customer focus - the customer is at the center

blocks.zh: Leadership — 領導力
blocks.en: Leadership - leadership

blocks.zh: Engagement of people — 人員參與
blocks.en: Engagement of people - involvement of personnel

blocks.zh: Process approach — 流程方法
blocks.en: Process approach - managing activities as processes

blocks.zh: Improvement — 持續改進
blocks.en: Improvement - continual improvement

blocks.zh: Evidence-based decision making — 基於證據的決策
blocks.en: Evidence-based decision making - decisions based on evidence

blocks.zh: Relationship management — 關係管理
blocks.en: Relationship management - managing relationships

blocks.zh: 0.2 解析 — 七大原則在包裝材料廠的體現
blocks.en: 0.2 Analysis - How the Seven Principles Show Up in a Packaging Material Plant

blocks.zh: Introduction 0.3 — Process Approach 流程方法
blocks.en: Introduction 0.3 - Process Approach

blocks.zh: 0.3 解析 — PDCA 與風險思維
blocks.en: 0.3 Analysis - PDCA and Risk-Based Thinking

blocks.zh: PDCA 在玻璃瓶製造的實際循環
blocks.en: The PDCA Cycle in Glass Vial Manufacturing

blocks.zh: Plan：設定每批玻璃瓶的尺寸規格 (dimensional spec) 和微粒標準
blocks.en: Plan: Set the dimensional specification and particulate standard for each glass vial batch

blocks.zh: Do：按 SOP 執行生產，進行線上控制 (IPC)
blocks.en: Do: Run production according to SOPs, with in-process control (IPC)

blocks.zh: Check：最終檢驗 (final inspection)，比對規格，統計製程能力 (Cpk)
blocks.en: Check: Final inspection against specification, with statistical process capability (Cpk)

blocks.zh: Act：發現不合格趨勢，調整成型參數或設備，更新 SOP
blocks.en: Act: When a nonconformance trend is found, adjust forming parameters or equipment and update the SOP

blocks.zh: 風險思維的具體化
blocks.en: Putting Risk-Based Thinking into Practice

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 特別強調：由於初級包裝材料直接接觸藥品，風險思維必須貫穿所有流程，不只是設計或驗證階段。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 stresses that, because primary packaging materials come into direct contact with the medicinal product, risk-based thinking must run through all processes, not only the design or validation stage.

blocks.zh: 舉例：橡膠塞供應商必須評估矽化處理 (siliconization) 對相容性的風險；鋁蓋廠商必須評估壓合力 (crimp force) 對封閉完整性的影響。
blocks.en: For example: a rubber stopper supplier must assess the compatibility risk of siliconization; an aluminum cap manufacturer must assess the effect of crimp force on container closure integrity.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 3.11 特別設有「風險管理相關術語」這個子章節。
blocks.en: This is why 3.11 has a dedicated subsection on "terms relating to risk management".

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽核查核點
blocks.en: CDMO Audit Checkpoints

blocks.zh: 請供應商展示其 PDCA 改進紀錄（CAPA 清單 + 完成率）
blocks.en: Ask the supplier to show its PDCA improvement records (CAPA list + completion rate)

blocks.zh: 查看是否有書面的風險評估 (risk assessment) 報告，涵蓋關鍵製程步驟
blocks.en: Check whether there is a documented risk assessment report covering the critical process steps

blocks.zh: 確認風險評估工具是否適當（FMEA、FTA 或 HACCP 均可接受）
blocks.en: Confirm that the risk assessment tools are appropriate (FMEA, FTA or HACCP are all acceptable)

blocks.zh: Introduction 0.4 — Relationship with Other Standards 與其他標準的關係
blocks.en: Introduction 0.4 - Relationship with Other Standards

blocks.zh: 0.4 解析 — 標準生態系統定位
blocks.en: 0.4 Analysis - Where the Standard Sits in the Standards Ecosystem

blocks.zh: Section 1 — Scope 適用範圍
blocks.en: Section 1 - Scope

blocks.zh: Section 1 解析 — 誰需要遵循？
blocks.en: Section 1 Analysis - Who Needs to Comply?

blocks.zh: 適用對象：初級包裝材料製造商
blocks.en: Target Audience: Primary Packaging Material Manufacturers

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 適用於設計、製造和供應初級包裝材料的組織。以下是常見的初級包裝材料：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 applies to organizations that design, manufacture and supply primary packaging materials. Common primary packaging materials include:

blocks.zh: 玻璃小瓶 (glass vials)、安瓶 (ampoules)
blocks.en: Glass vials, ampoules

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞 (rubber stoppers / closures)
blocks.en: Rubber stoppers / closures

blocks.zh: 鋁蓋 / 壓蓋 (aluminum crimp caps / seals)
blocks.en: Aluminum crimp caps / seals

blocks.zh: 塑料容器 (HDPE/PP/PET bottles)
blocks.en: Plastic containers (HDPE/PP/PET bottles)

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器部件 (prefilled syringe components)：筒體 (barrel)、活塞塞 (plunger stopper)、針頭護罩 (needle shield)、端蓋 (tip cap)
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe components: barrel, plunger stopper, needle shield, tip cap

blocks.zh: 泡殼包裝材料 (blister foils)：鋁箔 (aluminum foil)、PVC/PVDC 底材
blocks.en: Blister packaging materials (blister foils): aluminum foil, PVC/PVDC base film

blocks.zh: IV 袋 (intravenous bags)
blocks.en: IV bags (intravenous bags)

blocks.zh: 不適用範圍
blocks.en: Out of Scope

blocks.zh: 次級包裝（紙箱、說明書、標籤）→ 不直接接觸藥品
blocks.en: Secondary packaging (cartons, leaflets, labels) → no direct contact with the medicinal product

blocks.zh: 合約實驗室（只做檢測，不製造包裝材料）
blocks.en: Contract laboratories (testing only, not manufacturing packaging materials)

blocks.zh: 經銷商（只轉售，不涉及設計或製造）
blocks.en: Distributors (resale only, with no involvement in design or manufacturing)

blocks.zh: 藥品製造商本身（應遵循 EU GMP、ICH Q10 等）
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical manufacturers themselves (who should follow EU GMP, ICH Q10, etc.)

blocks.zh: CDMO QA 實務：供應商稽核的起點
blocks.en: CDMO QA Practice: Where a Supplier Audit Starts

blocks.zh: 確認供應商是否持有有效的 ISO 15378 認證書（Certificate of Registration）
blocks.en: Confirm that the supplier holds a valid ISO 15378 certificate (Certificate of Registration)

blocks.zh: 核對認證範圍是否涵蓋你採購的具體產品類別（例如：橡膠塞 vs 玻璃瓶是不同範疇）
blocks.en: Check that the certification scope covers the specific product category you purchase (for example, rubber stoppers and glass vials are different categories)

blocks.zh: 確認認證機構 (CB) 是否為 IAF 認可的 accredited body
blocks.en: Confirm that the certification body (CB) is an IAF-accredited body

blocks.zh: 查詢認證到期日及最近一次監督稽核 (surveillance audit) 的結果
blocks.en: Check the certificate expiry date and the result of the most recent surveillance audit

blocks.zh: Section 2 — Normative References 規範性引用文件
blocks.en: Section 2 - Normative References

blocks.zh: Section 2 解析 — 規範性引用的意義
blocks.en: Section 2 Analysis - The Meaning of Normative References

blocks.zh: 規範性 vs 資訊性引用
blocks.en: Normative vs Informative References

blocks.zh: 規範性引用 (normative reference)：引用文件構成 ISO 15378 的一部分，必須遵守。
blocks.en: Normative reference: the referenced document forms part of ISO 15378 and must be complied with.

blocks.zh: 資訊性引用 (informative reference)：提供補充背景，不強制要求。
blocks.en: Informative reference: provides supplementary background and is not mandatory.

blocks.zh: ISO 14698-1 和 -2 被列為規範性引用，代表潔淨室生物污染控制方法是 ISO 15378 的強制要求組成部分。
blocks.en: ISO 14698-1 and -2 are listed as normative references, which means the cleanroom biocontamination control methods are a mandatory component of ISO 15378.

blocks.zh: 為何 ISO 14698 被納入？
blocks.en: Why Is ISO 14698 Included?

blocks.zh: 初級包裝材料（特別是橡膠塞和注射器部件）的生產環境需要控制微生物污染。ISO 14698 定義了生物污染控制的系統方法，包括環境監控 (EM) 程序、樣品採集、數據解釋。
blocks.en: The production environment for primary packaging materials (especially rubber stoppers and syringe components) needs microbial contamination control. ISO 14698 defines a systematic approach to biocontamination control, including environmental monitoring (EM) programs, sample collection and data interpretation.

blocks.zh: 這意味著 ISO 15378 認證工廠的潔淨室生物污染控制必須符合 ISO 14698 的方法論，而不是任意設計的 EM 程序。
blocks.en: This means that biocontamination control in the cleanrooms of an ISO 15378-certified plant must follow the ISO 14698 methodology, rather than an arbitrarily designed EM program.

blocks.zh: Section 3 — Terms and Definitions 術語定義 (概述)
blocks.en: Section 3 - Terms and Definitions (Overview)

blocks.zh: Section 3 概覽 — 為什麼術語定義很重要
blocks.en: Section 3 Overview - Why Definitions Matter

blocks.zh: 術語統一的實務意義
blocks.en: The Practical Value of Consistent Terminology

blocks.zh: 在供應商協議 (Quality Agreement, Technical Agreement) 中，雙方必須使用一致的術語，否則容易產生歧義和糾紛。ISO 15378 的術語定義提供了客觀的法律依據。
blocks.en: In supplier agreements (Quality Agreement, Technical Agreement), both parties must use consistent terminology, otherwise ambiguity and disputes easily arise. The definitions in ISO 15378 provide an objective basis for this.

blocks.zh: 例如："batch"（批次）和 "lot"（批）在此標準中是同義詞，但如果藥廠和供應商對此有不同理解，可能導致可追溯性記錄不完整。
blocks.en: For example: "batch" and "lot" are synonyms in this standard, but if the pharmaceutical company and the supplier understand them differently, traceability records may be incomplete.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 新增術語 vs ISO 9000:2015 原有術語
blocks.en: New ISO 15378 Terms vs Original ISO 9000:2015 Terms

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 只重複定義 ISO 9000:2015 中已修改的術語（例如 organization、validation）。其他未列出的術語，直接引用 ISO 9000:2015 的原始定義。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 redefines only the terms from ISO 9000:2015 that it has modified (for example organization, validation). Terms not listed are taken directly from the original definitions in ISO 9000:2015.

blocks.zh: 因此閱讀 ISO 15378 Section 3 時，應同時參照 ISO 9000:2015。
blocks.en: Therefore, when reading Section 3 of ISO 15378, you should refer to ISO 9000:2015 at the same time.

blocks.zh: 3.1 Terms Related to Organization — 與組織相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.1 Terms Related to Organization

blocks.zh: 3.1 解析
blocks.en: 3.1 Analysis

blocks.zh: organization — 在本標準中的特定含義
blocks.en: organization - its specific meaning in this standard

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 的「組織」泛指任何類型的公司；ISO 15378 特別說明，在本標準語境中，組織是指製造初級包裝材料的公司。這個澄清很重要，確保標準的適用主體不被誤解為藥品製造商或其他角色。
blocks.en: In ISO 9001, "organization" refers to any type of company; ISO 15378 specifies that in the context of this standard, the organization is the company that manufactures primary packaging materials. This clarification matters because it prevents the subject of the standard from being misread as the pharmaceutical manufacturer or another party.

blocks.zh: quality unit — GMP 的核心組織架構
blocks.en: quality unit - the core organizational structure of GMP

blocks.zh: QU（品質單位）是 GMP 環境中的核心概念，相當於藥廠的「QA 部門」，但在小型包裝材料廠可能是一個人兼任。
blocks.en: The QU (quality unit) is a core concept in a GMP environment. It is equivalent to the "QA department" of a pharmaceutical company, though in a small packaging material plant it may be one person holding multiple roles.

blocks.zh: 關鍵職能：
blocks.en: Key functions:

blocks.zh: 批次放行 (batch release) 決定
blocks.en: Batch release decisions

blocks.zh: 偏差 (deviation) 調查和核准
blocks.en: Deviation investigation and approval

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核
blocks.en: Supplier audits

blocks.zh: 文件控制和 SOP 審核
blocks.en: Document control and SOP review

blocks.zh: 稽核時要確認 QU 在組織架構中的獨立性，不能直接向生產部門報告。
blocks.en: During an audit, confirm the independence of the QU within the organization; it must not report directly to production.

blocks.zh: 3.2 Terms Related to Activity — 與活動相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.2 Terms Related to Activity

blocks.zh: 3.2 解析 — 活動術語
blocks.en: 3.2 Analysis - Activity Terms

blocks.zh: change control — 變更控制的 GMP 意義
blocks.en: change control - its GMP significance

blocks.zh: 變更控制是 GMP 最核心的管理工具之一。ISO 15378 特別強調變更控制必須「文件化」，且需進行適當的風險管理。
blocks.en: Change control is one of the most essential management tools in GMP. ISO 15378 stresses that change control must be documented and must involve appropriate risk management.

blocks.zh: 為何如此重要？初級包裝材料的任何變更（哪怕只是原料供應商改變）都可能影響藥品的安全性和穩定性。藥廠可能需要重新進行相容性測試 (compatibility testing)，甚至向監管機構申報。
blocks.en: Why is it so important? Any change to a primary packaging material (even just a change of raw material supplier) may affect the safety and stability of the medicinal product. The pharmaceutical company may need to repeat compatibility testing, or even notify the regulatory authority.

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO QA 角度：供應商必須在變更前及時通知你，並提供充分的技術資料，讓你評估是否需要重新驗證 (revalidation)。
blocks.en: From the CDMO QA perspective: the supplier must notify you in a timely manner before making a change and provide enough technical data for you to assess whether revalidation is needed.

blocks.zh: qualification vs validation — 常見混淆澄清
blocks.en: qualification vs validation - clearing up a common confusion

blocks.zh: Qualification（確效/鑑定）：用於設備、設施、公用系統（utility）——證明它們能滿足規格要求。
blocks.en: Qualification: applied to equipment, facilities and utilities - demonstrating that they meet specified requirements.

blocks.zh: Validation（驗證）：用於製造流程、清潔程序、分析方法——證明流程能一致地產出預期結果。
blocks.en: Validation: applied to manufacturing processes, cleaning procedures and analytical methods - demonstrating that the process consistently delivers the intended results.

blocks.zh: 簡單說：確效你的洗瓶機 (IQ/OQ/PQ)，驗證洗瓶製程（清潔驗證）。
blocks.en: In short: you qualify your vial washer (IQ/OQ/PQ), and you validate the vial washing process (cleaning validation).

blocks.zh: IQ / OQ / PQ — 確效三部曲
blocks.en: IQ / OQ / PQ - the qualification trilogy

blocks.zh: 這是 GMP 環境中設備確效的標準步驟：
blocks.en: These are the standard steps of equipment qualification in a GMP environment:

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 在 3.2.7 特別說明：PQ 是一種 verification（確認），即提供客觀證據證明規格的適用性。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 states specifically in 3.2.7 that PQ is a form of verification, that is, providing objective evidence that the specified requirements are fit for the intended use.

blocks.zh: 3.3 Terms Related to System — 與系統相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.3 Terms Related to System

blocks.zh: 3.3 解析 — 系統術語
blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis - System Terms

blocks.zh: airlock — 氣閘的功能
blocks.en: airlock - what it does

blocks.zh: 氣閘是防止污染跨越潔淨等級的關鍵設施。ISO 15378 定義氣閘的核心功能是「控制氣流」，而非僅是一個過渡空間。
blocks.en: An airlock is a key facility for preventing contamination from crossing between cleanliness grades. ISO 15378 defines its core function as "controlling airflow", not merely serving as a transition space.

blocks.zh: 在初級包裝材料廠，氣閘用於：
blocks.en: In a primary packaging material plant, airlocks are used for:

blocks.zh: 人員進入潔淨區前的更衣/消毒
blocks.en: Gowning/disinfection of personnel before entering the clean area

blocks.zh: 物料從非潔淨區進入潔淨區的傳遞
blocks.en: Transfer of materials from non-clean areas into clean areas

blocks.zh: 防止不同潔淨等級之間的壓差失控
blocks.en: Preventing loss of control of the pressure differential between different cleanliness grades

blocks.zh: cleanroom vs clean zone — 兩者的區別
blocks.en: cleanroom vs clean zone - the difference

blocks.zh: Cleanroom（潔淨室）：一個完整的房間，結構設計本身就為了控制微粒。
blocks.en: Cleanroom: a complete room whose structural design is itself intended to control particles.

blocks.zh: Clean zone（潔淨區）：潔淨室內的特定空間，或由分離裝置（如隔離器 isolator、RABS）形成的區域。
blocks.en: Clean zone: a specific space within a cleanroom, or an area formed by a separation device (such as an isolator or RABS).

blocks.zh: 例如：整個灌裝室是潔淨室（ISO Class 8），其中的 RABS 填充區是潔淨區（ISO Class 5）。
blocks.en: For example: the whole filling room is a cleanroom (ISO Class 8), and the RABS filling area within it is a clean zone (ISO Class 5).

blocks.zh: 注意：ISO 15378 引用 ISO 14644-1 的定義，確保術語與潔淨室標準一致。
blocks.en: Note: ISO 15378 refers to the definitions in ISO 14644-1, ensuring that the terminology is consistent with the cleanroom standards.

blocks.zh: calibration — 校準與 GMP 的連結
blocks.en: calibration - the link to GMP

blocks.zh: 在 GMP 環境中，所有用於產品放行和製程控制的量測儀器都必須定期校準。ISO 15378 把校準定義為與參考標準比對的過程，強調可追溯性 (traceability to national/international standards)。
blocks.en: In a GMP environment, all measuring instruments used for product release and process control must be calibrated regularly. ISO 15378 defines calibration as a process of comparison against a reference standard, emphasizing traceability to national/international standards.

blocks.zh: 稽核時要確認：校準計畫是否完整？是否有逾期未校準的儀器？校準結果是否在接受標準內？
blocks.en: During an audit, confirm: Is the calibration program complete? Are any instruments overdue for calibration? Are the calibration results within the acceptance criteria?

blocks.zh: 3.4 Terms Related to Requirement — 與要求相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.4 Terms Related to Requirement

blocks.zh: 3.4 解析
blocks.en: 3.4 Analysis

blocks.zh: expiration date vs shelf-life — 初級包裝材料的效期
blocks.en: expiration date vs shelf-life - dating of primary packaging materials

blocks.zh: 藥品有效期大家都熟悉，但初級包裝材料本身也有效期，這是很多人忽略的重點。
blocks.en: Everyone is familiar with the expiry date of a medicinal product, but primary packaging materials themselves also have a shelf-life, a point many people overlook.

blocks.zh: 以橡膠塞為例：矽化 (siliconization) 效果可能隨時間降低，或溶出物 (extractables) 可能在長期存放後超標。因此供應商必須定義：
blocks.en: Take rubber stoppers as an example: the effect of siliconization may decline over time, or extractables may exceed limits after long-term storage. The supplier must therefore define:

blocks.zh: 在何種儲存條件下（溫度、濕度、光照）
blocks.en: Under what storage conditions (temperature, humidity, light)

blocks.zh: 材料可以保持規格符合性多久（shelf-life）
blocks.en: How long the material remains in conformance with specification (shelf-life)

blocks.zh: 逾期後不得使用（expiration date）
blocks.en: After which it must not be used (expiration date)

blocks.zh: CDMO 的收料程序 (receiving procedure) 必須核查包裝材料的效期，避免使用過期材料。
blocks.en: The CDMO's receiving procedure must check the expiry of packaging materials to avoid using expired material.

blocks.zh: 3.5 Terms Related to Process — 與過程相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.5 Terms Related to Process

blocks.zh: 3.5 解析 — 過程術語
blocks.en: 3.5 Analysis - Process Terms

blocks.zh: batch/lot — 批次的核心地位
blocks.en: batch/lot - the central role of the batch

blocks.zh: 批次是 GMP 可追溯性的基本單位。所有的品質紀錄、測試結果、放行決定都與特定批次掛鉤。
blocks.en: The batch is the basic unit of GMP traceability. All quality records, test results and release decisions are tied to a specific batch.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的定義強調兩個關鍵特性：
blocks.en: The ISO 15378 definition emphasizes two key characteristics:

blocks.zh: 均一性 (uniform characteristics)：同一批次的所有產品應具有一致的品質屬性
blocks.en: Uniform characteristics: all products in the same batch should have consistent quality attributes

blocks.zh: 均質性 (homogeneous quality)：批次內不允許有系統性的品質差異
blocks.en: Homogeneous quality: no systematic quality differences are allowed within a batch

blocks.zh: 批次定義對於抽樣計畫 (sampling plan) 的設計至關重要——必須清楚知道批次的邊界在哪裡。
blocks.en: The batch definition is critical for designing the sampling plan - you must know clearly where the batch boundaries lie.

blocks.zh: contamination 的三種形式
blocks.en: The three forms of contamination

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 特別列出三種污染類型，這對於包裝材料廠特別重要：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 specifically lists three types of contamination, which is particularly important for packaging material plants:

blocks.zh: 物理污染 (physical/particulate)：玻璃碎片、金屬微粒、纖維
blocks.en: Physical (particulate) contamination: glass fragments, metal particles, fibers

blocks.zh: 化學污染 (chemical)：溶出物 (leachables)、殘留清潔劑、塑化劑
blocks.en: Chemical contamination: leachables, residual cleaning agents, plasticizers

blocks.zh: 生物污染 (biological)：微生物 (bioburden)、內毒素 (endotoxin)
blocks.en: Biological contamination: microorganisms (bioburden), endotoxin

blocks.zh: 這三類污染都可能危害藥品安全，因此包裝材料廠必須針對每一類建立控制措施。
blocks.en: All three types can compromise the safety of the medicinal product, so a packaging material plant must establish controls for each of them.

blocks.zh: reprocessing vs reconditioning — 重要區別
blocks.en: reprocessing vs reconditioning - an important distinction

blocks.zh: Reprocessing（再加工）：重複部分生產步驟。例如橡膠塞第一次矽化效果不符標準，重新矽化。需要有書面的核准程序。
blocks.en: Reprocessing: repeating part of the production steps. For example, if the first siliconization of rubber stoppers does not meet the standard, they are siliconized again. A documented approval procedure is required.

blocks.zh: Reconditioning（重新整備）：對初級包裝材料進行加工或再加工以達到規格要求。概念更廣，包含外部重新處理。
blocks.en: Reconditioning: processing or reprocessing a primary packaging material to bring it to specification. The concept is broader and includes treatment carried out externally.

blocks.zh: 兩者都需要品質單位的評估和核准，並在批次紀錄中記錄。
blocks.en: Both require evaluation and approval by the quality unit and must be recorded in the batch record.

blocks.zh: surface treatment — 表面處理對相容性的影響
blocks.en: surface treatment - its effect on compatibility

blocks.zh: 表面處理是初級包裝材料特有的概念。以矽化 (siliconization) 為例：
blocks.en: Surface treatment is a concept specific to primary packaging materials. Take siliconization as an example:

blocks.zh: 目的：減少橡膠塞與注射器筒之間的摩擦，確保順暢滑動
blocks.en: Purpose: reduce friction between the rubber stopper and the syringe barrel to ensure smooth sliding

blocks.zh: 風險：矽油可能遷移到藥品中 (leaching)，影響蛋白質藥物 (biologics) 的穩定性
blocks.en: Risk: silicone oil may migrate into the medicinal product (leaching), affecting the stability of protein drugs (biologics)

blocks.zh: GMP 要求：矽化程度必須在規格範圍內，並有驗證數據支持
blocks.en: GMP requirement: the degree of siliconization must be within the specification range and supported by validation data

blocks.zh: 藥廠在進行 extractables & leachables (E&L) 研究時，必須了解所使用包裝材料的表面處理情況。
blocks.en: When conducting extractables & leachables (E&L) studies, pharmaceutical companies must understand the surface treatment of the packaging materials used.

blocks.zh: quarantine — 隔離狀態的實務管理
blocks.en: quarantine - practical management of the quarantine status

blocks.zh: 隔離狀態是 GMP 物料管理的關鍵概念。物料從收料到放行前，必須處於隔離狀態，防止未經放行的物料被誤用。
blocks.en: Quarantine status is a key concept in GMP material management. From receipt until release, materials must be held in quarantine to prevent unreleased materials from being used by mistake.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 說明隔離可以是「物理隔離」（獨立區域）或「其他有效方式」（如電腦系統中的隔離標記）。現代倉庫管理系統 (WMS) 通常以電子方式實現隔離管理，但必須有適當的系統驗證 (IT system validation)。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 states that quarantine can be "physical segregation" (a separate area) or "other effective means" (such as a quarantine flag in a computer system). Modern warehouse management systems (WMS) usually implement quarantine electronically, but this requires appropriate system validation (IT system validation).

blocks.zh: 3.6 Terms Related to Results — 與結果相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.6 Terms Related to Results

blocks.zh: 3.6 解析 — 結果術語
blocks.en: 3.6 Analysis - Result Terms

blocks.zh: primary packaging material — 標準的核心概念
blocks.en: primary packaging material - the core concept of the standard

blocks.zh: 這是整份標準最重要的定義。直接接觸藥品是初級包裝材料的決定性特徵。
blocks.en: This is the most important definition in the whole standard. Direct contact with the medicinal product is the defining characteristic of a primary packaging material.

blocks.zh: 典型的初級包裝材料：
blocks.en: Typical primary packaging materials:

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器：小瓶 (vials)、安瓶 (ampoules)、卡匣 (cartridges)
blocks.en: Glass containers: vials, ampoules, cartridges

blocks.zh: 橡膠製品：瓶塞 (stoppers)、活塞 (plungers)、O 型環
blocks.en: Rubber products: stoppers, plungers, O-rings

blocks.zh: 金屬製品：鋁壓蓋 (aluminum seals/crimp caps)
blocks.en: Metal products: aluminum seals/crimp caps

blocks.zh: 塑料容器：HDPE/PP 藥瓶、PET 容器、IV 袋
blocks.en: Plastic containers: HDPE/PP medicine bottles, PET containers, IV bags

blocks.zh: 泡殼材料：PVC/PVDC 底材、鋁蓋箔 (lidding foil)
blocks.en: Blister materials: PVC/PVDC base film, aluminum lidding foil

blocks.zh: 注射器組件：筒體、活塞塞、針頭護罩
blocks.en: Syringe components: barrel, plunger stopper, needle shield

blocks.zh: 次級包裝材料不在 ISO 15378 範圍內
blocks.en: Secondary packaging materials are outside the scope of ISO 15378

blocks.zh: 紙箱、標籤、說明書等不直接接觸藥品的包裝材料，不屬於 ISO 15378 的管轄範疇。這些材料的供應商只需符合 ISO 9001 或其他適用標準。
blocks.en: Packaging materials that do not directly contact the medicinal product, such as cartons, labels and leaflets, are outside the jurisdiction of ISO 15378. Suppliers of these materials only need to comply with ISO 9001 or other applicable standards.

blocks.zh: 但注意：印有藥品資訊的標籤雖然是次級包裝，但因為攸關藥品安全資訊，仍受 EU GMP Annex C (Annex 15378 Annex C) 和 EU GMP Part II 的相關規定約束。
blocks.en: Note, however: a label printed with medicinal product information is secondary packaging, but because it carries information critical to product safety, it is still subject to the relevant provisions of EU GMP Annex C (Annex 15378 Annex C) and EU GMP Part II.

blocks.zh: intermediate product — 在過程中的品質控制
blocks.en: intermediate product - in-process quality control

blocks.zh: 以橡膠塞製造為例：
blocks.en: Take rubber stopper manufacturing as an example:

blocks.zh: 混煉後的橡膠 → starting material
blocks.en: Compounded rubber → starting material

blocks.zh: 成型後、未矽化的橡膠塞 → intermediate product
blocks.en: Molded, not yet siliconized stoppers → intermediate product

blocks.zh: 矽化、清洗、包裝後的橡膠塞 → finished product
blocks.en: Stoppers after siliconization, washing and packing → finished product

blocks.zh: 每個階段都需要有 in-process controls 和適當的隔離管理。
blocks.en: Each stage requires in-process controls and appropriate quarantine management.

blocks.zh: 3.7 Terms Related to Data, Information and Document — 與資料、資訊及文件相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.7 Terms Related to Data, Information and Document

blocks.zh: 3.7 解析 — 文件術語
blocks.en: 3.7 Analysis - Document Terms

blocks.zh: batch record — GMP 的核心文件
blocks.en: batch record - a core GMP document

blocks.zh: 批次紀錄是 GMP 可追溯性的根本。ISO 15378 定義批次紀錄必須：
blocks.en: The batch record is the foundation of GMP traceability. ISO 15378 defines the batch record as one that must:

blocks.zh: 提供批次的完整歷史（生產 + 控制）
blocks.en: Provide the complete history of the batch (production + control)

blocks.zh: 能夠追溯 (facilitate traceability)
blocks.en: Facilitate traceability

blocks.zh: 一份完整的批次紀錄應包含：原料資訊、設備編號、操作步驟、IPC 結果、偏差記錄、最終放行簽核。
blocks.en: A complete batch record should include: raw material information, equipment numbers, operating steps, IPC results, deviation records and final release sign-off.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在評估包裝材料供應商時，應要求查閱批次紀錄的樣本，確認記錄完整性和清晰度。
blocks.en: When evaluating a packaging material supplier, the CDMO should ask to review sample batch records to confirm completeness and legibility.

blocks.zh: deviation — 偏差管理的法規要求
blocks.en: deviation - regulatory expectations for deviation management

blocks.zh: 偏差的定義是「偏離核准的 SOP 或建立的標準」。這意味著即使最終產品符合規格，偏差本身就需要調查和記錄。
blocks.en: A deviation is defined as a departure from an approved SOP or an established standard. This means that even if the final product meets specification, the deviation itself must be investigated and recorded.

blocks.zh: GMP 偏差管理的步驟：
blocks.en: Steps in GMP deviation management:

blocks.zh: 發現偏差 → 立即紀錄
blocks.en: Deviation detected → record immediately

blocks.zh: 隔離相關批次（如需要）
blocks.en: Quarantine the affected batches (if needed)

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析 (RCA)
blocks.en: Root cause analysis (RCA)

blocks.zh: 評估對產品品質的影響
blocks.en: Assess the impact on product quality

blocks.zh: 制定 CAPA
blocks.en: Establish CAPA

blocks.zh: 品質單位核准後才能放行
blocks.en: Release only after approval by the quality unit

blocks.zh: OOS — 超出規格結果的處理
blocks.en: OOS - handling out-of-specification results

blocks.zh: OOS 定義清晰：測試結果不符合規格。這觸發正式的 OOS 調查程序，包括：
blocks.en: The OOS definition is clear: a test result that does not meet the specification. This triggers a formal OOS investigation procedure, including:

blocks.zh: Phase 1：實驗室調查（排除分析誤差）
blocks.en: Phase 1: laboratory investigation (rule out analytical error)

blocks.zh: Phase 2：製造調查（是否有製程問題）
blocks.en: Phase 2: manufacturing investigation (check for process problems)

blocks.zh: 最終決定：重新測試（如有合理理由）或拒收/報廢
blocks.en: Final decision: retest (if there is a justified reason) or reject/scrap

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的 OOS 管理框架直接對應 FDA OOS 指引（21 CFR context）和 EU GMP Chapter 6 的要求。
blocks.en: The ISO 15378 OOS management framework corresponds directly to the FDA OOS guidance (21 CFR context) and the requirements of EU GMP Chapter 6.

blocks.zh: URS — 設備採購的起點文件
blocks.en: URS - the starting document for equipment procurement

blocks.zh: URS（使用者需求規格）是確效生命週期的第一步。它定義了：
blocks.en: The URS (user requirement specification) is the first step of the qualification lifecycle. It defines:

blocks.zh: 設備需要生產什麼產品
blocks.en: What products the equipment needs to produce

blocks.zh: 功能性要求（產能、速度）
blocks.en: Functional requirements (capacity, speed)

blocks.zh: 操作要求（環境條件、清潔方式）
blocks.en: Operational requirements (environmental conditions, cleaning method)

blocks.zh: 技術要求（材質、電氣規格）
blocks.en: Technical requirements (materials of construction, electrical specifications)

blocks.zh: URS 必須在採購前核准，並作為後續 IQ/OQ/PQ 的基準文件。
blocks.en: The URS must be approved before purchase and serves as the baseline document for the subsequent IQ/OQ/PQ.

blocks.zh: validation vs verification — 最常見的混淆
blocks.en: validation vs verification - the most common confusion

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 在 3.7.13 特別補充：verification 也可以透過 IQ 和 OQ 來執行，說明這兩個概念在 GMP 設備確效框架中的連結。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 adds in 3.7.13 that verification can also be carried out through IQ and OQ, illustrating how these two concepts are linked in the GMP equipment qualification framework.

blocks.zh: 3.8 Terms Related to Action — 與行動相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.8 Terms Related to Action

blocks.zh: 3.8 解析 — 行動術語
blocks.en: 3.8 Analysis - Action Terms

blocks.zh: batch release — 批次放行的決策架構
blocks.en: batch release - the decision framework

blocks.zh: 批次放行是品質系統中最重要的決策節點。ISO 15378 明確要求：
blocks.en: Batch release is the most important decision point in the quality system. ISO 15378 clearly requires that:

blocks.zh: 必須進行正式審查（不是非正式的口頭確認）
blocks.en: A formal review must be performed (not an informal verbal confirmation)

blocks.zh: 必須審查批次紀錄（不只是測試結果）
blocks.en: The batch record must be reviewed (not just the test results)

blocks.zh: 必須由品質單位或其授權人員執行（確保獨立性）
blocks.en: It must be performed by the quality unit or its authorized personnel (to ensure independence)

blocks.zh: 從藥廠 CDMO 的角度：你收到的包裝材料 CoA（合格證書）背後，代表供應商的品質單位已審核並簽核了所有批次紀錄。稽核時應查閱放行 SOP 和授權人員清單。
blocks.en: From the CDMO's perspective as a pharmaceutical company: behind the CoA (certificate of analysis) you receive with packaging materials is the supplier's quality unit having reviewed and signed off all the batch records. During an audit, review the release SOP and the list of authorized persons.

blocks.zh: rework — 返工的特殊規定
blocks.en: rework - special provisions

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 特別補充：分選 (sorting) 可以視為返工。這在初級包裝材料廠很常見：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 adds that sorting can be regarded as rework. This is common in primary packaging material plants:

blocks.zh: 例如：一批玻璃瓶中發現部分有氣泡缺陷，需要逐瓶目視檢查並剔除不良品。這個分選過程按照 ISO 15378 的定義屬於 rework，必須有核准的 SOP 和記錄。
blocks.en: For example: bubble defects are found in part of a batch of glass vials, requiring vial-by-vial visual inspection and removal of defective units. Under the ISO 15378 definition, this sorting process is rework and must have an approved SOP and records.

blocks.zh: 任何返工都需要品質單位評估對產品品質的影響，並決定是否需要重新測試。
blocks.en: Any rework requires the quality unit to assess the impact on product quality and decide whether retesting is needed.

blocks.zh: 3.9 Terms Related to Characteristic — 與特性相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.9 Terms Related to Characteristic

blocks.zh: 3.9 解析
blocks.en: 3.9 Analysis

blocks.zh: homogeneity — 與 batch 定義的連結
blocks.en: homogeneity - the link to the batch definition

blocks.zh: 均質性是批次定義的核心特徵。橡膠配方的均質性確保批次內所有橡膠塞的機械性能（硬度、彈性、穿刺力）一致；玻璃成分的均質性確保熱膨脹係數一致，防止熱應力破裂。
blocks.en: Homogeneity is the core characteristic of the batch definition. Homogeneity of the rubber formulation ensures consistent mechanical properties (hardness, elasticity, penetration force) across all stoppers in a batch; homogeneity of the glass composition ensures a consistent coefficient of thermal expansion and prevents thermal stress breakage.

blocks.zh: sterile — 初級包裝材料的無菌要求
blocks.en: sterile - sterility requirements for primary packaging materials

blocks.zh: 不是所有初級包裝材料都需要無菌狀態，但用於無菌製劑的材料通常需要。ISO 15378 採用 ISO/TS 11139 的定義：無菌 = 不含存活微生物。
blocks.en: Not all primary packaging materials need to be sterile, but materials used for sterile products usually do. ISO 15378 adopts the ISO/TS 11139 definition: sterile = free from viable microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞和玻璃瓶通常由藥廠在使用前進行最終滅菌（高溫蒸汽、乾熱、EO 等），或以輻射滅菌後的形式供應。無論哪種方式，供應商必須提供符合規格的生物負荷 (bioburden) 數據。
blocks.en: Rubber stoppers and glass vials are usually terminally sterilized by the pharmaceutical company before use (steam, dry heat, EO, etc.), or supplied in a form already sterilized by irradiation. Either way, the supplier must provide bioburden data that meets specification.

blocks.zh: 3.10 Terms Related to Determination — 與確定相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.10 Terms Related to Determination
3.10 Analysis

blocks.zh: automated inspection — 現代品質控制的核心
blocks.en: automated inspection - the core of modern quality control

blocks.zh: 自動化檢驗在初級包裝材料廠已是標配。ISO 15378 特別定義此術語，並提供具體技術例子（光電、雷射、超音波），說明自動化檢驗系統的多樣性。
blocks.en: Automated inspection is now standard in primary packaging material plants. ISO 15378 defines this term specifically and gives concrete technology examples (optical, laser, ultrasonic) to illustrate the variety of automated inspection systems.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO QA 而言，稽核自動化檢驗系統時需確認：
blocks.en: For CDMO QA, when auditing an automated inspection system, confirm that:

blocks.zh: 設備已完成確效（IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: The equipment has been qualified (IQ/OQ/PQ)

blocks.zh: 拒絕邏輯和閾值設定有書面依據
blocks.en: The rejection logic and threshold settings have a documented basis

blocks.zh: 假拒率和假接率定期評估
blocks.en: The false reject and false accept rates are evaluated regularly

blocks.zh: 系統校準紀錄完整
blocks.en: System calibration records are complete

blocks.zh: in-process control (IPC) — 製程中的品質關卡
blocks.en: in-process control (IPC) - the quality checkpoints within the process

blocks.zh: IPC 是在生產過程中（而非最終產品）進行的品質確認。ISO 15378 特別補充：環境控制和設備控制也屬於 IPC 的一部分。
blocks.en: IPC is quality confirmation performed during production (rather than on the final product). ISO 15378 adds that environmental controls and equipment controls are also part of IPC.

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶製造的典型 IPC 項目：
blocks.en: Typical IPC items in glass vial manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 尺寸檢查（容積、壁厚、瓶口尺寸）
blocks.en: Dimensional checks (volume, wall thickness, neck dimensions)

blocks.zh: 外觀目視或自動化檢查（氣泡、結石、裂紋）
blocks.en: Visual or automated inspection (bubbles, stones, cracks)

blocks.zh: 模式重量監控
blocks.en: Mold weight monitoring

blocks.zh: 潔淨室溫濕度和壓差記錄（環境 IPC）
blocks.en: Cleanroom temperature, humidity and differential pressure records (environmental IPC)

blocks.zh: reconciliation — 物料平衡的重要性
blocks.en: reconciliation - the importance of material balance

blocks.zh: 物料平衡是 GMP 防止混淆和計算錯誤的重要工具。公式：理論產量 = 實際產量 + 廢料 + 樣品 + 其他可解釋的損失。
blocks.en: Reconciliation is an important GMP tool for preventing mix-ups and calculation errors. The formula: theoretical yield = actual yield + waste + samples + other accountable losses.

blocks.zh: 如果物料平衡超出可接受範圍，必須調查是否有產品丟失或混批的可能性。這也是防止藥品包裝材料流入非預期通路的控制手段之一。
blocks.en: If the reconciliation falls outside the acceptable range, you must investigate whether product has been lost or batches mixed. This is also one of the controls that prevent pharmaceutical packaging materials from flowing into unintended channels.

blocks.zh: 3.11 Terms Relating to Risk Management — 與風險管理相關的術語
blocks.en: 3.11 Terms Relating to Risk Management

blocks.zh: 3.11 解析 — 風險管理術語（ISO 15378 的特色）
blocks.en: 3.11 Analysis - Risk Management Terms (a Distinctive Feature of ISO 15378)

blocks.zh: 質量關鍵 (quality critical) — 最重要的術語之一
blocks.en: quality critical - one of the most important terms

blocks.zh: "Quality critical" 是 ISO 15378 獨有的術語，在其他 ISO 標準中不常見。這個概念直接對應製藥產業的 Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) 和 Critical Process Parameters (CPP) 概念。
blocks.en: "Quality critical" is a term unique to ISO 15378 and is uncommon in other ISO standards. The concept corresponds directly to the pharmaceutical industry's Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) and Critical Process Parameters (CPP).

blocks.zh: 判斷標準：若某個參數不符合要求，可能對患者安全產生重大不利後果，則為 quality critical。
blocks.en: Criterion: if a parameter fails to meet its requirement and may have a significant adverse effect on patient safety, it is quality critical.

blocks.zh: 包裝材料的 quality critical 參數範例：
blocks.en: Examples of quality critical parameters for packaging materials:

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞的穿刺粒子 (coring) 傾向 → 直接影響注射安全
blocks.en: Coring tendency of rubber stoppers → directly affects injection safety

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶的封閉完整性 → 關乎無菌屏障
blocks.en: Container closure integrity of glass vials → relates to the sterile barrier

blocks.zh: 鋁蓋的壓合力 (crimp force) → 決定瓶蓋密封性
blocks.en: Crimp force of aluminum caps → determines the sealing of the closure

blocks.zh: 泡殼鋁箔的密封強度 → 防止藥品暴露於濕氣
blocks.en: Seal strength of blister aluminum foil → prevents exposure of the medicinal product to moisture

blocks.zh: 與 ICH Q9 的對應關係
blocks.en: Correspondence with ICH Q9

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的風險管理術語與 ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) 高度一致，因為兩者都引用 ISO Guide 73。這意味著已熟悉 ICH Q9 的製藥人員，在理解 ISO 15378 的風險管理要求時幾乎不需要重新學習術語。
blocks.en: The risk management terms in ISO 15378 are highly consistent with ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management), because both refer to ISO Guide 73. This means pharmaceutical professionals already familiar with ICH Q9 need almost no relearning of terminology to understand the risk management requirements of ISO 15378.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常用的風險工具（FMEA、Fishbone、FTA）在 ISO 15378 的風險管理框架中都是可接受的方法。
blocks.en: The risk tools commonly used by CDMOs (FMEA, fishbone, FTA) are all acceptable methods within the ISO 15378 risk management framework.

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核重點：風險管理成熟度評估
blocks.en: Supplier audit focus: assessing risk management maturity

blocks.zh: 要求查閱最近一次對製程的正式風險評估報告（特別是 quality critical 參數的識別）
blocks.en: Ask to review the most recent formal risk assessment report for the process (especially the identification of quality critical parameters)

blocks.zh: 確認 change control 流程中是否有系統性的風險評估步驟
blocks.en: Confirm that the change control process includes a systematic risk assessment step

blocks.zh: 查核是否對新原料或新設備進行了風險評估
blocks.en: Check whether risk assessments were performed for new raw materials or new equipment

blocks.zh: 評估供應商是否能清晰說明哪些製程步驟是 quality critical，以及控制策略
blocks.en: Assess whether the supplier can clearly explain which process steps are quality critical and what the control strategy is

blocks.zh: 風險管理的完整流程
blocks.en: The complete risk management process

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 按照 ISO Guide 73 定義了風險管理的完整術語鏈：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 defines the complete chain of risk management terms in line with ISO Guide 73:

blocks.zh: Key Terms Summary — 核心術語快速參考
blocks.en: Key Terms Summary - Quick Reference

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 雙軌架構總結
blocks.en: Summary of the ISO 15378 Dual-Track Architecture

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 = ISO 9001 + GMP：哪裡不同？
blocks.en: ISO 15378 = ISO 9001 + GMP: What Is Different?

blocks.zh: 相較於純粹的 ISO 9001，ISO 15378 在以下領域增加了 GMP 特定要求：
blocks.en: Compared with plain ISO 9001, ISO 15378 adds GMP-specific requirements in the following areas:

blocks.zh: 術語層面：新增 batch, GMP, IQ/OQ/PQ, validation, quality critical, line clearance 等 GMP 特有術語
blocks.en: Terminology: adds GMP-specific terms such as batch, GMP, IQ/OQ/PQ, validation, quality critical and line clearance

blocks.zh: 組織層面：強制要求設立 quality unit，確保 QA/QC 職能的獨立性
blocks.en: Organization: mandates the establishment of a quality unit, ensuring the independence of the QA/QC functions

blocks.zh: 文件層面：增加 batch record, SOP, URS 等 GMP 文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation: adds GMP document requirements such as batch record, SOP and URS

blocks.zh: 製程層面：增加 IPC、change control、deviation management、reconciliation
blocks.en: Process: adds IPC, change control, deviation management and reconciliation

blocks.zh: 風險層面：增加 quality critical 概念和 risk management 術語體系
blocks.en: Risk: adds the quality critical concept and a system of risk management terminology

blocks.zh: 如何向非技術人員解釋 ISO 15378
blocks.en: How to Explain ISO 15378 to Non-Technical Colleagues

blocks.zh: 想像建造一棟安全的建築：
blocks.en: Imagine constructing a safe building:

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 = 一般建築法規（結構完整、防火、電氣安全）
blocks.en: ISO 9001 = general building codes (structural integrity, fire protection, electrical safety)

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 = 醫院建築法規（一般建築法規 + 醫療等級的額外要求：無菌區、手術室標準、醫療氣體系統等）
blocks.en: ISO 15378 = hospital building codes (general building codes + additional medical-grade requirements: sterile areas, operating room standards, medical gas systems, etc.)

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 認證就是告訴藥廠：這家供應商的「工廠」已按醫療等級標準建造和運作，不需要你從頭審查。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 certification tells the pharmaceutical company: this supplier's "plant" has been built and operated to medical-grade standards, so you do not need to review it from scratch.
